Category:

0 flagged
How to use:
1. Select a category from the toolbar
2. Click tiles to flag them
3. Use UNFLAG to remove flags
4. Click Copy Results to get the list
5. Paste it back to Claude

Categories:
BG=background visible, HALO=edge glow, STRIPPED=over-removed,
PARTICLES=floating specks, PINK_BLEED=pink color contamination,
UGLY=processing damage, BAD_GEN=wrong style/perspective,
UNUSED=not referenced by game, OK=good tile
